title: JANUS Engine R0A2 — POMS membrane selection, realistic packing and startup gate

design_decision.primary_membrane: poly(octylmethylsiloxane) (POMS) thin-film membrane on porous non-woven support with PAN-coated support layer, following the closest published direct artificial-gill + PEMFC precedent
design_decision.reason: This exact material class has already been demonstrated as a water-blocking oxygen-permeable artificial-gill interface in a recirculating PEMFC system. Its measured behavior is therefore more relevant to JANUS Mode A than gas-only O2/N2 membranes or artificial-lung membranes operated in the opposite transfer direction.
design_decision.boundary: Backup candidates are geometry/material analogs only until water-to-gas dissolved-O2 extraction is independently measured under JANUS conditions.

published_POMS_anchor.reported_explanation_for_reduced_effecti: possible condensation droplets on membrane surfaces; passive heat exchange/drying was proposed as mitigation
published_POMS_anchor.water_side_transfer_dominance: In the paper's nominal model c1/c2 was about 56, meaning water-side convective mass-transfer resistance dominated membrane resistance.
published_POMS_anchor.prototype_flow_problem: CFD showed most water streamlines concentrated in a narrow central core because the desktop demonstrator used a small inlet/outlet relative to module area.

JANUS_crown_realistic_flat_stack_rescale.supersedes_assumption: The earlier 423.5 m2 R0A1 hollow-fiber area remains a high-area hollow-fiber screening candidate, but it cannot be treated as a realizable POMS flat-stack area inside the same 700 mm x 500 mm crown. At the published flat-stack packing density, the crown contains about 21.2 m2, not 423.5 m2.
JANUS_crown_realistic_flat_stack_rescale.design_consequence: For the first self-drive experiment, reducing auxiliary power is more valuable than forcing hundreds of square metres into the crown.

preferred_configuration.name: POMS_SECTORED_ANNULAR_CROSS_FLOW_STACK
architecture: thin POMS selective layer on supported membrane sheets
4 mm-class water channels as an initial literature-anchored geometry
sectorized annular cassettes around the 62.3 mm rotating Axle
distributed water headers around circumference instead of one small central inlet
short hydraulic path lengths and parallel lanes to minimize DeltaP
passive or very-low-power gas-side heat exchanger / demister before membrane return
Axle drives only flow-refresh or pumping functions whose measured benefit exceeds torque cost
preferred_configuration.main_optimization_target: raise water-side h1 and active-flow utilization while preventing condensation; intrinsic POMS permeance is not the first bottleneck in the published model

scaled_water_flow_reference.boundary: This is geometric scaling from the 2025 prototype, not a pump prescription. JANUS must measure DeltaP(Q) and not infer pump power from flow alone.

startup_dynamic_gate.principle: Do not judge self-drive at t=0. Startup is a transient inventory-conditioning problem and readiness is determined by state convergence, not by an arbitrary elapsed time.

stages: PRIME: fill water lanes, establish leak-free gas recirculation and humidity control
DRAW_DOWN: fuel cell consumes internal O2 until pO2_internal falls below water-equivalent dissolved-O2 partial pressure and a strong membrane gradient forms
FLUX_LOCK: membrane O2 influx approaches fuel-cell O2 consumption
LOAD_TRANSFER: starter/buffer source progressively hands pump/fan/control loads to PEMFC
SELF_DRIVE_HOLD: sustained positive net power with stable pO2, humidity, temperature and independent O2 mass-balance closure

published_system_inventory_screen.warning: These are lower-bound inventory times because membrane O2 influx begins during drawdown; real settling can be longer. The 2025 experiments were run for hours and evaluated at equilibrium.

MODE_B_INTEGRATED_VRU_AKS.principle: Longer commissioning is expected because sorbents must reach cyclic steady state and thermal/cryogenic inventories must condition. User operational experience of roughly 1 to 4 days on a legacy integrated air-separation installation is retained as a historical reference, not a universal JANUS startup constant.
MODE_B_INTEGRATED_VRU_AKS.literature_boundary: PSA/TSA performance is normally evaluated only after cyclic steady state; startup optimization literature explicitly treats the number of cycles to CSS as a separate problem.

provisional_ready_conditions: pO2_internal no longer drifting materially at fixed load
membrane O2 influx equals fuel-cell O2 consumption within declared uncertainty
water-side O2 loss agrees with gas-side O2 gain
humidity/condensate rate is bounded and no progressive membrane wetting is detected
net electrical power remains positive after all currently active auxiliaries
for cyclic sorbent mode, successive cycles converge to a declared CSS tolerance

external_references.role: artificial-gill hollow-fiber geometry and pumping-energy precedent
PSA startup and cyclic-steady-state optimization precedent
PDMS/PVDF and Matrimid-PDMS hollow-fiber backup geometry precedent

next_gate: JANUS_ENGINE_SIM_HOWL_CASTLE_RUN_005_POMS_STARTUP: rerun with a realizable ~21.2 m2 POMS flat-stack crown, two PEMFC conversion-efficiency cases, explicit startup buffer, and auxiliary-power budgets rather than the old arbitrary 100 W fixed overhead.
